messages.subject: index.Rmd conflicts with the apps?
parts: Hello, on my shiny server, the apps work fine but when after including index.Rmd under /srv/shiny-server, the file is rendered fine but the apps will no longer work, just saying "Not found". The apps work fine again after delete the Rmd file and restarting the server. Any hint on what goes wrong? Or how to fix? Thanks in advance, Ahmed.
